header.running_head: 3. The Rights and Duties of Muslims

blocks.tamil_translation: Then Allah Ta'ala will make their faces and their clothes full of light. On the Day of Qiyamah, when the general public will be in terror, they will have no terror of any kind; they are the friends of Allah Ta'ala; they will have no fear, nor will they grieve.” Hazrat Abu Malik Ash'ari (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ مَسْعُوْدٍ ﵁ قَالَ: جَاءَ رَجُلٌ اِلَي رَسُوْلِ اللهِ ﷺ فَقَالَ: يَارَسُوْلَ اللهِ! كَيْفَ تَقُوْلُ فِيْ رَجُلٍ اَحَبَّ قَوْمًا وَلَمْ يَلْحَقْ بِهِمْ؟ فَقَالَ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ ﷺ: اَلْمَرْءُ مَعَ مَنْ اَحَبَّ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه البخاري باب علامة الحب في الله ...رقم:٦١٦٩
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abdullah ibn Mas'ud (RA) says: “A man came into the presence of the Prophet ﷺ and asked, “O Rasulullah, a man loves a group of people, but he is unable to join them! (he is unable to follow them fully in deeds and good works); what is your view about him?” Rasulullah ﷺ replied, “Whoever loves someone will be with him; in the Hereafter he will be joined with them.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ اَبِيْ اُمَامَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ ﷺ: مَااَحَبَّ عَبْدٌ عَبْدًا لِلّهِ اِلَّا اَكْرَمَ رَبَّهُ .
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Umamah (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said: “Whichever servant loves another servant for the sake of Allah Ta'ala has honoured his Lord, the Most Great.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ اَبِيْ ذَرٍّ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ ﷺ: اَفْضَلُ اْلاَعْمَالِ
